name: ~ Let's drink tubular secretion together so we can go to the sky door ~
source:
Drink tubular secretion pee with your beloved sister together so you can go into the sky door, a parallel world where you and your beloved sister is together!

[From [url=https://izakikoparadox.itch.io/lets-drink-tubular-secretion-together-so-we-can-go-to-the-sky-door]itch.io[/url]]
